Hi Samantha — thanks for sending the questionnaire and timeline. I wanted to provide the concrete artifacts and technical details you asked for so procurement/security can review quickly. Short answers up-front and attachments with examples below.

SOC / compliance
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit covering our hosted and dedicated inference services on 2025-11-12; scope includes change management, access controls, and incident response.
- HIPAA: We offer a BAA and have implemented administrative/technical safeguards relevant to PHI workloads; formal attestation in procurement pack (draft BAA) attached.
- Pen testing: annual 3rd-party pentest reports available under NDA — we can share the latest executive summary and remediation log.

Identity & Access
- SSO: full SAML 2.0 support with IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows; we provide step-by-step Okta and Azure AD guides.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 provisioning supported; recommended attribute set and sample mapping attached (scim_mapping_example.json). We support bulk sync and delta (incremental) updates; provisioning events include create, update, deactivate.
- RBAC: Role model includes Organization Admin, Billing Admin, App Admin, and Read-only Auditor. Org Admin promotions require an approval ticket and two approvers by default.
- Audit logs: API-level audit logs retained for 12 months by default; extended retention options and log export (S3/Cloud Storage) available as add-on.

Attachments included here: scim_mapping_example.json, redwood_socs_status_brief.pdf

Next steps proposed:
1) We will populate your vendor security questionnaire and return a filled PDF by Thu 09/02.
2) Schedule a 30-minute SCIM mapping call (Hiro is available Mon/Tue mornings PST).
3) Provide SOC executive summary and BAA draft under a mutual NDA (link or signed NDA will do).

If you prefer, we can load the questionnaire into a shared Google Drive and track answers inline — whatever works best for procurement.
